messages:
Jen (Support): raising an escalation from ACME integration. rerank endpoint returning 503s and occasionally 'all scores equal' for some queries with emojis. customer pasted payload sample

Alex (Backend): can you paste the raw bytes they send (not rendered emoji)? want to see surrogates/nulls/zwj stuff

Jen (Support): they sent this exact JSON (copied from request):
```json
{
  "query": "status of order \ud83d\udc4d\u200d\u2642\ufe0f",
  "candidates": ["Order #123", "Order #124"]
}
```

Mira (ML): that looks like an emoji with ZWJ and VARIATION SELECTOR sequences. unpaired surrogate escapes are suspicious: \ud83d\udc4d is fine, but the extra sequences might confuse our tokenizer boundary logic and produce an empty token stream for candidates in some normalization paths

Tay (SRE): log excerpt from the customer's failed request (sanitized):
```
2026-02-14T19:23:11Z ERROR request_id=abcd1234 rerank-handler failed to compute features: TokenizerError: invalid utf16 surrogate pair at offset 23
2026-02-14T19:23:11Z WARN request_id=abcd1234 fallback -> 503 upstream
```

Alex (Backend): repro locally with node:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/rerank \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer x' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"query":"status of order \uD83D\uDC4D\u200D\u2642\uFE0F","candidates":["Order #123","Order #124"]}'
```

I can trigger the TokenizerError when the request hits the Java tokenizer path (we have both rust/java depending on instance). Java path throws, rust path currently tries to coerce and then ranking scores collapse to ~0.5 each (observed equal scores)

Mira (ML): equal scores happen when the feature extraction returns NaN or zero vectors; our ranker L2-normalizes and if features are all zeros you get tied scores. sounds like certain normalization sequences drop all grapheme clusters from the candidate or strip query yielding degenerate features

Jen (Support): customer says truncation also happens when they include zero-width-joiner + skin-tone modifiers in the query. they need a short-term workaround while we triage

Alex (Backend): short-term mitigations: 1) gateway-level sanitizer that removes isolated `\ud800-\udfff` unpaired surrogates and zero-width control chars; 2) API doc note: advise callers to send UTF-8 normalized (NFC) and to encode emojis as actual UTF-8 bytes (not escape sequences) if possible; 3) return a 400 with clear message instead of 503 when we detect invalid sequences (preferable)

Tay (SRE): I can push a hotfix to the request gateway to convert surrogate escapes to replacement char and reject outright if byte sequence is invalid. will add a metric for sanitizer_reject_count. quick patch ready in staging

Mira (ML): for longer term we should update tokenizer to treat emoji clusters and combining marks as atomic tokens and make feature extractor robust to empty-token candidates. I'll open a ticket to add a unit test with multiple emoji cluster permutations + ZWJ/VS modifiers

Alex (Backend): created GH issue #4872: "Handle unpaired surrogates and emoji cluster boundaries in rerank tokenizer" with repro and logs. PR for gateway sanitizer in review: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/7264 (staging green)

deploy-bot: deploy started for sanitizer-hotfix -> staging (job: deploy-9012) :rocket:

Jen (Support): replied to customer: "we see the malformed/edge-case emoji clusters causing our tokenizer to error. temporary workaround: replace escaped surrogates with real UTF-8 emoji or strip ZWJ sequences. we're pushing a gateway fix to staging now and will update you within 2 hours." :thumbsup:

Tay (SRE): staging running for 30m, sanitizer rejects ~7 requests from their org and returns 400 with helpful message. planning prod rollout in 1h if no regressions

Mira (ML): added test cases to the eval suite, including sequences: ZWJ+SKIN_TONE, unpaired high surrogate, multiple VS-16. ensures ranker doesn't produce NaNs

Alex (Backend): follow-up action items:
- prod roll of gateway sanitizer (Tay)
- tokenizer hardening (Mira)
- update API docs + add example sanitizer snippet in support KB (Jen)
- monitor for related 5xxs and tied-scores (alert on percent tied > 0.1%)

Jen (Support): closing loop with customer, will file RFC for API behavior on invalid-encoding handling per above.

Tay (SRE): PROD roll complete, metric shows sanitizer_reject_count for that org dropped retries, 5xxs for rerank reduced to 0 for that client. closing incident unless someone objects

Mira (ML): adding the tokenizer patch to next release train. good catch.
